headline: Alphabet Agrees to Acquire Wiz in $32 Billion Cloud Security Deal
body: Alphabet Inc. has reached a definitive agreement to acquire Wiz, the fast-growing cloud security startup, for approximately $32 billion in cash. The deal, the largest acquisition in Alphabet history, marks Google Cloud's most aggressive push into cybersecurity. Wiz reported $1.7 billion in annualized recurring revenue as of late 2025. The transaction is expected to close in the second half of 2026 pending regulatory approval. CEO Sundar Pichai called the acquisition 'transformative' for Google Cloud's enterprise security portfolio.

headline: Microsoft Completes $18B Acquisition of Nuance-Rival Suki AI
body: Microsoft Corporation finalized its $18 billion acquisition of Suki AI, a healthcare AI voice platform, closing the deal two months after announcement. The transaction was approved by the Federal Trade Commission with minor data-sharing conditions. Suki's technology will be integrated into Microsoft Cloud for Healthcare, bringing ambient clinical intelligence to 120,000 physician users. This acquisition strengthens Microsoft's Azure Health Data Services platform and follows the successful integration of Nuance Communications.

headline: ExxonMobil Bids $27B for Denbury Resources Rival Talos Energy
body: ExxonMobil has submitted a $27 billion all-cash offer for Talos Energy, an independent oil and gas exploration company with significant carbon capture infrastructure. The bid represents a 35% premium to Talos' 30-day volume-weighted average price. Analysts say ExxonMobil is seeking to accelerate its carbon capture and storage (CCS) ambitions while adding 180,000 barrels per day of production capacity in the Gulf of Mexico. The Talos board has formed a special committee to evaluate the proposal.

headline: Apollo Global Management to Acquire Comcast's NBCUniversal Stake for $14B
body: Apollo Global Management announced a deal to acquire a 40% stake in NBCUniversal from Comcast for $14 billion in cash, valuing the media giant at $35 billion. The transaction will help Comcast de-lever its balance sheet ahead of a planned spin-off of cable networks including MSNBC, CNBC, and Bravo. Apollo intends to explore strategic options for the acquired properties, including potential mergers with other media companies. Regulatory filings are expected within 30 days.

headline: JPMorgan Chase Acquires Brazilian Fintech Nubank's B2B Unit for $8.5B
body: JPMorgan Chase completed the acquisition of Nubank's business banking division in a transaction valued at $8.5 billion. The deal gives JPMorgan immediate access to over 2 million small and medium-sized business clients across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. The acquisition is part of JPMorgan's broader Latin American expansion strategy, announced in Q4 2025. Nubank will retain its consumer banking operations and will continue to operate independently in those markets. The deal closed ahead of schedule.

headline: BlackRock Closes $12.5B Acquisition of HPS Investment Partners
body: BlackRock Inc. officially closed its acquisition of HPS Investment Partners, the private credit manager, for $12.5 billion in a cash-and-stock deal. The transaction, which received all necessary regulatory approvals, brings HPS's $148 billion in assets under management into BlackRock's alternative investments platform. BlackRock's total AUM now stands at approximately $12.5 trillion. CEO Larry Fink described the deal as 'the largest acquisition in BlackRock's history' and said HPS would anchor its private credit business.

headline: Pfizer Buys OncoBiologics for $9.2B to Bolster Oncology Pipeline
body: Pfizer announced a $9.2 billion acquisition of OncoBiologics, a bispecific antibody developer with three late-stage cancer therapies. The lead product, ONC-221, showed 68% response rates in triple-negative breast cancer Phase III trials. The deal adds significant pipeline depth to Pfizer's oncology division following the LOE cliff from Ibrance. The transaction is expected to close in Q3 2026 subject to FDA review and shareholder approval. Pfizer financed the deal with existing cash and a $4 billion term loan.

headline: Chevron Raises Hess Merger Offer Amid Arbitration Dispute to $58B
body: Chevron Corp raised its offer for Hess Corporation to $58 billion in revised terms, adding a $2.3 billion cash sweetener to resolve ongoing arbitration disputes over Hess's 30% stake in the ExxonMobil-operated Stabroek Block in Guyana. The revised deal came after an international arbitration panel issued a preliminary finding that ExxonMobil and CNOOC have valid rights of first refusal over the Guyana asset. Hess shareholders are scheduled to revote on the revised terms in April 2026.

headline: Visa Acquires Featurespace for $4.1B in AI Fraud Detection Push
body: Visa Inc. announced the acquisition of Featurespace, a British AI company specializing in real-time fraud detection and adaptive behavioral analytics, for approximately $4.1 billion. Featurespace's ARIC Risk Hub processes over 180 billion fraud signals annually. Visa plans to integrate the technology into its global payment network, which handles over $14 trillion in annual transaction volume. The deal is expected to close in Q2 2026 pending approval from the UK's Competition and Markets Authority.

headline: Amazon Web Services to Acquire Databricks Rival Starburst Data for $6B
body: Amazon Web Services announced an agreement to acquire Starburst Data, an open-source analytics engine company based on Trino, for $6 billion. The deal will integrate Starburst's distributed query engine into AWS Athena, significantly improving query performance for large-scale data lake workloads. Starburst had raised $414 million in venture capital and was processing over 50 petabytes of data queries daily. The transaction is subject to U.S. antitrust review.

headline: UnitedHealth Group Acquires Amedisys in $3.3B Home Health Deal
body: UnitedHealth Group's Optum division completed the $3.3 billion acquisition of Amedisys, one of the nation's largest home health and hospice providers. The deal, which cleared a two-year antitrust review, required the divestiture of 106 care centers in overlapping markets. Amedisys serves more than 500,000 patients annually across 39 states. The acquisition strengthens Optum's post-acute care capabilities and is expected to generate $200 million in annual synergies by 2028.

headline: KKR to Acquire Telecom Italia's Fixed Network for €22B in Landmark Deal
body: KKR and Telecom Italia (TIM) signed a binding agreement for KKR to acquire TIM's fixed-line infrastructure network for €22 billion (approximately $24 billion), creating an independent wholesale network operator for Italy. The transaction, approved by the Italian government under its golden power rules, transfers TIM's landline infrastructure while allowing TIM to continue using the network as a major tenant. The deal includes €2.2 billion in potential earnout payments tied to network upgrade milestones.

headline: Salesforce Acquires Informatica for $11.4B to Dominate Enterprise Data
body: Salesforce completed its third attempt to acquire Informatica for $11.4 billion, after two previous failed deals in 2024. The acquisition gives Salesforce Informatica's Master Data Management platform and AI-powered cloud data integration capabilities, which process data for 5,000 enterprise customers. The combined entity is expected to challenge Oracle and SAP in the enterprise data market. Salesforce financed the deal through a combination of stock and $5.5 billion in new debt.

headline: Goldman Sachs Buys NN Investment Partners for €1.6B to Expand European AUM
body: Goldman Sachs Asset Management completed the acquisition of NN Investment Partners, the Dutch insurance giant's investment arm, for €1.6 billion (approximately $1.75 billion). The acquisition brings €355 billion in assets under management and adds significant European fixed income and ESG capabilities. NN Investment Partners is the second-largest asset manager in the Netherlands. Goldman Sachs' total AUM now exceeds $3 trillion following the transaction.

headline: Shell Acquires TotalEnergies' LNG Portfolio for $15B in Strategic Swap
body: Shell and TotalEnergies announced a sweeping asset swap in which Shell will acquire TotalEnergies' 50% stake in the Mozambique LNG project and other LNG assets valued at $15 billion, while TotalEnergies receives Shell's downstream refining operations in Europe. The complex transaction is the largest asset swap in the oil and gas industry since 2014. Shell said the deal significantly enhances its global LNG trading position, giving it control of over 15 mtpa of new capacity.

headline: Broadcom Acquires VMware Rival HashiCorp for $6.4B to Expand Multi-Cloud
body: Broadcom Inc. announced the acquisition of HashiCorp, the open-source infrastructure automation company, for $6.4 billion in cash. HashiCorp's Terraform, Vault, and Consul products are used by over 3,000 enterprise customers for multi-cloud infrastructure management. The acquisition follows Broadcom's successful integration of VMware and extends its enterprise software portfolio. Terraform alone is used by an estimated 1.5 million practitioners globally, representing a massive installed base.

headline: Private Equity Consortium Bids $45B for Walgreens Boots Alliance
body: A private equity consortium led by Sycamore Partners, Carlyle Group, and Leonard Green & Partners submitted a $45 billion bid for Walgreens Boots Alliance, proposing to take the struggling pharmacy chain private. The bid represents a 42% premium to Walgreens' 60-day VWAP. The consortium plans to separate the U.S. pharmacy operations from the Boots UK retail chain and potentially pursue a sale of Walgreens' specialty pharmacy segment. Walgreens' board has retained Goldman Sachs and Morgan Stanley as advisors.

headline: Novo Nordisk Acquires Cardior Pharmaceuticals for $2.8B in RNA Drug Push
body: Novo Nordisk announced the acquisition of Cardior Pharmaceuticals, a German RNA therapeutics startup, for €2.6 billion ($2.8 billion) upfront plus up to €700 million in milestones. Cardior's CDR132L, an RNA drug targeting heart failure, is in Phase III trials with results expected in Q4 2026. The deal represents Novo Nordisk's largest acquisition in the cardiovascular space since its GLP-1 dominance. Analysts noted the deal diversifies Novo's pipeline beyond obesity and diabetes.

headline: Intel Explores Sale of Networking Chip Division as Restructuring Deepens
body: Intel Corporation is exploring the sale of its networking and edge computing chip business, according to people familiar with the matter. Potential buyers include Marvell Technology, Broadcom, and a consortium of private equity firms, with valuation estimates ranging from $7 billion to $12 billion. Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan is pursuing an asset-light strategy focused on the foundry business and PC/data center CPUs. The division generated approximately $2.1 billion in revenue in 2025.

headline: Barclays Acquires Tesco Bank's Consumer Finance Business for £700M
body: Barclays Bank PLC completed the acquisition of Tesco Bank's consumer credit card and personal loan operations for £700 million (approximately $880 million). The transaction transfers approximately 4 million customer accounts and £9.4 billion in loan balances to Barclays. Barclays gains access to Tesco's Clubcard loyalty data for targeted financial product offers. The deal includes a 10-year commercial partnership for Barclays to offer financial products to Tesco's 20 million loyalty programme members.

headline: Starwood Capital Acquires $5B Real Estate Portfolio from Brookfield
body: Starwood Capital Group announced the acquisition of a diversified commercial real estate portfolio from Brookfield Asset Management for approximately $5 billion, comprising 45 office and logistics properties across the United States and Europe. The transaction, one of the largest commercial real estate deals of early 2026, reflects continued activity in the distressed commercial real estate market as interest rates begin to ease. Starwood plans to reposition several office assets as mixed-use developments.

headline: NVIDIA Acquires Run:ai for $700M to Deepen GPU Orchestration
body: NVIDIA Corporation completed its acquisition of Run:ai, the Israeli AI workload orchestration software company, for $700 million, after the deal received Israeli regulatory approval. Run:ai's platform manages GPU resource allocation across AI training and inference workloads for over 300 enterprise clients. The acquisition enables NVIDIA to offer end-to-end AI infrastructure management alongside its DGX systems and networking products. Antitrust authorities in the EU had initially raised concerns but ultimately cleared the deal.

headline: Anthem Blue Cross Renamed Elevance Acquires Molina Healthcare for $19B
body: Elevance Health (formerly Anthem) announced a $19 billion all-cash acquisition of Molina Healthcare, a managed care organization serving 5.3 million Medicaid and Medicare Advantage members. The combined entity will have over 48 million members and generate approximately $225 billion in annual revenues, rivaling UnitedHealth Group in scale. The deal requires approval from state insurance regulators in 19 states where Molina operates. Analysts note the transaction significantly expands Elevance's government-sponsored business.

headline: Thermo Fisher to Buy Catalent for $16.5B to Boost CDMO Capacity
body: Thermo Fisher Scientific announced a definitive agreement to acquire Catalent, the pharmaceutical contract development and manufacturing organization, for $16.5 billion. The deal accelerates Thermo Fisher's clinical manufacturing capabilities and adds 50 global facilities. Catalent's GLP-1 manufacturing infrastructure is a key strategic asset given surging demand for obesity and diabetes drugs. Novo Nordisk, which had previously invested $1.1 billion in Catalent, agreed to sell its stake as part of the transaction.

headline: Lennar and D.R. Horton in Merger Talks Valuing Combined Entity at $65B
body: Lennar Corporation and D.R. Horton are in early-stage merger discussions that would create the world's largest homebuilder with a combined market capitalization exceeding $65 billion. Together, the companies closed approximately 150,000 homes in fiscal year 2025. Both companies have been beneficiaries of the U.S. housing undersupply, but face margin pressure from elevated land costs. A merger would generate significant synergies in land acquisition, supplier contracts, and mortgage origination volumes.

headline: Warren Buffett's Berkshire Hathaway Discloses $6B Stake in Constellation Brands
body: Berkshire Hathaway disclosed a $6 billion equity stake in Constellation Brands, the wine, beer, and spirits company, representing approximately 9.8% of shares outstanding. The filing did not disclose whether Berkshire intends to pursue full acquisition, but analysts speculate about a potential take-private given Constellation's depressed valuation following a difficult 2025. Constellation's portfolio includes Corona Extra, Modelo Especial, and Robert Mondavi wines. The disclosure caused Constellation's shares to surge 22% in after-hours trading.

headline: Reliance Industries Acquires Walt Disney's India Operations for $8.5B
body: Reliance Industries' JioCinema streaming division completed its merger with The Walt Disney Company's India operations, including the Star India brand and Hotstar streaming platform, valuing the combined entity at $8.5 billion. The merged company, JioStar, becomes India's dominant media company with 750 million viewers across streaming, broadcast, and movies. Reliance holds a 55% controlling stake, with Disney retaining 45%. The deal gives Disney significant cash repatriation and a strong minority stake in the world's most populous market.

headline: Nestlé Divests North American Water Brands to One Rock Capital for $4.3B
body: Nestlé SA completed the sale of its North American water brands, including Poland Spring, Deer Park, Ice Mountain, Ozarka, and Zephyrhills, to One Rock Capital Partners for $4.3 billion. The brands were rebranded as BlueTriton Brands at closing. The transaction allowed Nestlé to focus on higher-margin premium brands like Perrier, S.Pellegrino, and Acqua Panna. One Rock plans to invest in new filtration technology and expand distribution through specialty retail channels.

headline: Airbus Acquires Spirit AeroSystems' European Operations for €1.05B
body: Airbus SE completed the acquisition of Spirit AeroSystems' European operations, including facilities in Belfast (Bombardier wing components), Prestwick (Scotland), and Toulouse (nacelle components), for approximately €1.05 billion. The move was triggered by Boeing's acquisition of Spirit AeroSystems' core fuselage business. Airbus' acquisition secures its supply chain for the A220, A320, and A350 programs and eliminates a critical single-point-of-failure in its production system.

headline: Apple Acquires AI Video Startup Reel AI for $1.1B to Power iPhone Filmmaking
body: Apple quietly completed the acquisition of Reel AI, a San Francisco-based startup specializing in generative video production and real-time video enhancement, for approximately $1.1 billion. The acquisition is expected to power new iPhone 18 Pro camera features announced at WWDC 2026. Reel AI's core technology enables on-device cinematic mode, object removal, and AI-directed scene composition. Apple has completed 14 acquisitions in the generative AI space over the past 18 months.

headline: Deutsche Telekom Bids €14B for Liberty Global's European Assets
body: Deutsche Telekom AG submitted a formal bid of approximately €14 billion for Liberty Global's remaining European cable operations, including assets in Belgium, Switzerland, Poland, and Slovakia. The acquisition would give Deutsche Telekom access to 12 million additional cable subscribers and strategic fiber infrastructure. The transaction requires approval from the European Commission under EU Merger Regulation. Liberty Global confirmed receipt of the offer and said it is evaluating the proposal with financial advisors.

headline: ConocoPhillips Acquires Marathon Oil in $22.5B All-Stock Deal
body: ConocoPhillips closed its all-stock acquisition of Marathon Oil Corporation, valued at $22.5 billion including assumed debt. The deal, initially announced in June 2024, received all necessary regulatory clearances. Marathon's Permian Basin acreage, Eagle Ford shale position, and Bakken assets add approximately 300,000 barrels per day of production to ConocoPhillips. The combined company operates in 13 countries and has a production capacity exceeding 2 million barrels of oil equivalent per day.

headline: Stripe Acquires Bridge.xyz for $1.1B in Stablecoin Payment Push
body: Stripe finalized the $1.1 billion acquisition of Bridge.xyz, a stablecoin payments infrastructure company, amid rising enterprise demand for dollar-denominated stablecoin settlement. Bridge processes over $50 billion in stablecoin transactions monthly and counts Coinbase, Robinhood, and SpaceX as clients. Stripe will integrate Bridge's technology into its global payment platform, enabling businesses to settle in USDC and PYUSD across 100+ countries. The deal is the largest stablecoin infrastructure acquisition on record.

headline: Moderna Acquires Eyrie Genomics for $3.5B to Enter Rare Disease Market
body: Moderna Inc. announced the acquisition of Eyrie Genomics, a gene editing company with three rare disease programs using next-generation base-editing technology, for $3.5 billion in cash plus $900 million in CVRs. The deal marks Moderna's strategic expansion beyond infectious disease vaccines. Eyrie's lead program, EYR-401, targets rare ATTR amyloidosis and has shown complete correction in animal models. Moderna's CEO Stéphane Bancel said gene editing will be the company's 'next growth engine.'

headline: SoftBank Group Acquires Ampere Computing for $6.5B to Build AI Chip Empire
body: SoftBank Group Corp. reached a definitive agreement to acquire Ampere Computing, the Arm-based server chip designer backed by Oracle, for $6.5 billion. The deal positions SoftBank to capitalize on surging data center demand for energy-efficient AI inference chips. Ampere's chips, used by Microsoft Azure, Oracle Cloud, and Alibaba Cloud, consume 70% less power than comparable x86 alternatives. The acquisition complements SoftBank's majority stake in Arm Holdings, creating a vertically integrated chip ecosystem.

headline: Lowe's Acquires Artisan Design Group for $1.3B to Capture Contractor Market
body: Lowe's Companies announced the acquisition of Artisan Design Group (ADG), the largest flooring and countertop installation services company serving homebuilders in the United States, for $1.3 billion. ADG serves 100 of the top 200 homebuilders and completed 500,000 installation projects in 2025. Lowe's sees the acquisition as a direct channel to the professional homebuilder market and a hedge against consumer spending volatility. The deal is expected to close in Q2 2026.

headline: Advent International Acquires Baxter's BioPharma Solutions Unit for $4.25B
body: Advent International completed the $4.25 billion acquisition of Baxter International's BioPharma Solutions business, a contract manufacturing organization for injectable drugs and biologic therapies. The business, now rebranded as Simtra BioPharma Solutions, serves over 200 pharmaceutical company clients from 7 global manufacturing sites. Baxter used proceeds to reduce debt following pressure from activists over its capital structure. Simtra is expected to pursue independent growth and potential acquisitions of complementary CDMO assets.

headline: Meta Platforms Acquires Scale AI for $14.3B in Landmark AI Data Deal
body: Meta Platforms announced the acquisition of Scale AI, the AI training data and annotation platform, for $14.3 billion in a combination of cash and Meta stock. Scale AI's data labeling infrastructure has been used to train models at OpenAI, Microsoft, Amazon, and the U.S. Department of Defense. CEO Alexandr Wang will join Meta to lead an AI Data Division. The deal is the largest AI acquisition of 2026 to date and is expected to face significant antitrust scrutiny from the FTC.

headline: BP Divests North Sea Portfolio to Ithaca Energy for £2.1B Amid Restructuring
body: BP PLC completed the sale of its non-operated North Sea oil and gas assets to Ithaca Energy for £2.1 billion ($2.65 billion), as part of BP's accelerated $25 billion divestiture program under CEO Murray Auchincloss. The assets include stakes in Elgin-Franklin, West Franklin, and Shearwater fields, producing approximately 50,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day. BP shares rose 3.2% on the news as investors welcomed progress in its debt reduction strategy.

headline: Honeywell Acquires Carrier Global's Security Division for $5.2B
body: Honeywell International reached a deal to acquire Carrier Global's Fire & Security segment for $5.2 billion in cash. The business includes the LenelS2 access control platform, Kidde fire safety products, and Chubb alarm monitoring services with 2 million commercial building installations. Honeywell expects the acquisition to be immediately accretive to earnings per share and generate $150 million in annual cost synergies. Carrier used proceeds to fund its Viessmann climate solutions integration.

headline: Ant Group Acquires Paytm Parent One97 Communications for $3.8B
body: Ant Group completed a $3.8 billion acquisition of One97 Communications, parent company of Paytm, following regulatory approval from the Reserve Bank of India. The deal gives Ant Group effective control of India's largest digital payments platform with 400 million registered users. The acquisition was contingent on Ant Group restructuring its shareholding to comply with RBI's foreign investment rules for payment system operators. Paytm will continue to operate under its existing brand in India.

headline: GE Vernova Acquires Actify Energy for $2B to Dominate Grid Software
body: GE Vernova announced the acquisition of Actify Energy, a grid management software company, for $2 billion in cash. Actify's platform is deployed in 35 electric utility markets across 18 countries and processes real-time data from over 1.2 million distributed energy resources. The deal accelerates GE Vernova's electrification software strategy and positions it to capitalize on the rapidly growing grid modernization market, estimated at $200 billion over the next decade.

headline: Alphabet's DeepMind Unit Acquires Isomorphic Labs Pharma Partners for $1.9B
body: Google DeepMind acquired the remaining 30% stake in Isomorphic Labs, its AI drug discovery spinoff, for $1.9 billion, effectively consolidating full ownership. Isomorphic had licensed its AlphaFold-based platform to Eli Lilly and Novartis in deals totaling $3 billion in biobucks. The move signals DeepMind's commitment to AI-accelerated drug discovery as a standalone revenue stream. Isomorphic's pipeline includes seven internal drug candidates across oncology and metabolic disease.

headline: Mastercard Acquires Recorded Future Cybersecurity Intelligence for $2.65B
body: Mastercard completed the acquisition of Recorded Future, the world's largest threat intelligence company, for $2.65 billion from Insight Partners. Recorded Future collects, analyzes, and delivers real-time cyber threat intelligence to over 1,900 clients in 75 countries, including government agencies and Fortune 500 companies. Mastercard plans to integrate Recorded Future's intelligence into its cybersecurity services for financial institutions globally, protecting over $9 trillion in annual transaction volume.

headline: Volkswagen Group Acquires Rivian's Commercial Van Unit for $5B
body: Volkswagen Group AG agreed to acquire Rivian Automotive's Commercial Van Manufacturing division, including the Amazon-backed EDV platform and manufacturing operations in Normal, Illinois, for approximately $5 billion. The deal, separate from VW's existing $5.8 billion software joint venture with Rivian, transfers commercial production assets while keeping the Rivian consumer brand and software platform independent. Amazon will continue as the anchor customer with a 100,000-van commitment.

headline: Abu Dhabi Investment Authority Acquires $10B Stake in OpenAI
body: The Abu Dhabi Investment Authority (ADIA) led a $10 billion secondary share purchase from existing OpenAI investors, becoming one of the company's largest shareholders at approximately 7% equity stake. The transaction, structured as a tender offer to early employees and Series B/C investors, valued OpenAI at $140 billion. ADIA joins Microsoft and SoftBank as strategic investors in OpenAI. The deal comes amid growing competition from Anthropic, Google Gemini, and Meta Llama in the foundation model market.

headline: Cigna Acquires Humana's Medicare Advantage Business for $23.5B
body: Cigna Group reached a definitive agreement to acquire Humana's Medicare Advantage business unit for $23.5 billion in cash and stock, creating a combined managed care giant with over 30 million Medicare beneficiaries. The deal was structured to avoid antitrust issues by excluding Humana's Medicaid and commercial insurance operations. The Medicare Advantage market has grown to cover over 50% of all Medicare beneficiaries, making it the most competitive segment of the U.S. health insurance market.

headline: Tencent Acquires Riot Games Parent Stake for $7.3B to Gain Full Control
body: Tencent Holdings Limited acquired the remaining minority stakes in Riot Games from early investors and employee shareholders for approximately $7.3 billion, gaining 100% ownership of the League of Legends developer. The buyout values Riot Games at $35 billion, reflecting a 10x revenue multiple on Riot's $3.5 billion in annual revenues from gaming, esports, and music IP. The deal required FTC approval under new gaming industry merger guidelines issued in late 2025.

headline: Year in Review: 2025 M&A Volume Hit $3.8 Trillion, Highest Since 2021
body: Global M&A activity reached $3.8 trillion in 2025, recovering to the highest annual level since 2021's record $5.1 trillion. Technology deals dominated at $1.2 trillion (32% of total), driven by AI-related acquisitions. Healthcare was second at $780 billion, led by pharma consolidation. Energy and resources reached $420 billion on oil supermajor consolidation. Private equity buyouts contributed $890 billion, the highest since 2022. Analysts forecast 2026 M&A to exceed $4 trillion as interest rate cuts and AI-driven synergies drive deal momentum.

headline: Qualcomm Drops Bid for Intel as Restructuring Path Becomes Clear
body: Qualcomm Inc. formally withdrew its $100+ billion acquisition proposal for Intel Corporation, citing regulatory complexity and Intel's improving operational trajectory under new CEO Lip-Bu Tan. Qualcomm had made informal approaches in Q3 2025 for Intel's PC chip and networking divisions but faced opposition from Chinese regulators and concerns from Intel's engineering talent. Qualcomm will instead focus on organic growth in its automotive and PC SoC businesses, where it has gained significant market share.

headline: Disney and Sony Pictures Announce $12B Joint Venture for Streaming Classics
body: The Walt Disney Company and Sony Pictures Entertainment announced a $12 billion joint venture to co-develop, distribute, and license classic film and TV IP across streaming platforms. The JV, called StudioVault, will manage a combined library of over 40,000 titles and pursue licensing deals with Netflix, Apple TV+, and Amazon Prime. Disney contributes its pre-2010 library; Sony contributes Columbia Pictures, TriStar, and Screen Gems content. Revenue sharing is split 55/45 in favor of Disney.

headline: Ares Management Raises $34B for Largest Private Credit Fund in History
body: Ares Management Corporation held the final close of Ares Capital Europe VI at $34 billion, the largest private credit fund ever raised. The fund was oversubscribed by $6 billion, reflecting institutional demand for private credit as a hedge against public market volatility. LPs include sovereign wealth funds from the Middle East, European pension funds, and U.S. insurance companies. Ares will deploy capital in senior secured loans, unitranche facilities, and first-lien debt across European mid-market companies.

headline: Saudi Aramco Acquires 10% Stake in Renault's Horse Powertrain JV for €1.4B
body: Saudi Aramco announced the acquisition of a 10% equity stake in Horse Powertrain Limited, the combustion engine joint venture between Renault and Geely, for €1.4 billion. The investment values Horse Powertrain at €14 billion and gives Aramco a platform to develop hydrogen-compatible and e-fuel combustion technology. Horse produces approximately 5 million engines annually. Aramco sees the investment as aligned with its 'lower-carbon' engine strategy as EV adoption varies globally.

headline: TSMC Acquires Intel Foundry's Arizona Fab Assets for $5.5B
body: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company reached an agreement with Intel to acquire the equipment, tooling, and facility improvements at Intel's Arizona Fab 52 and Fab 62 for $5.5 billion. TSMC will operate the fabs as an extension of its U.S. manufacturing presence, supplementing its TSMC Arizona campus. The U.S. government facilitated the transaction under the CHIPS Act framework, providing an additional $2 billion in federal incentives. Production at the Intel-TSMC fabs is expected to begin in late 2026.

headline: Bridgewater Associates Takes $8B Stake in Chinese State Banks Before Trump Tariffs
body: Bridgewater Associates disclosed a $8 billion combined position in Agricultural Bank of China, Bank of China, and Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC) ahead of anticipated U.S.-China trade negotiations. The move by Ray Dalio's successor team signals conviction that valuation discounts on Chinese state banks will narrow. China's largest banks trade at 0.5x book value compared to 1.5x for U.S. peers. The investment includes H-share positions on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange.
